# Bootstrap examples

The stylesheets in this folder come unchanged from the official Bootstrap 5.1.3 examples:
`bootstrap-5.1.3-examples.zip` from https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/releases/tag/v5.1.3.

- `sign-in/signin.css` from the Sign-in example, used by `admin-login.html`.
- `dashboard/dashboard.css` from the Dashboard example, used by `admin.html`.
